articles.title: Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
articles.zh: 医学图像分割：基础模型适配与任务专用训练的对比
articles.summary: 如果你正在纠结医学图像分割该从零训专用模型还是微调基础模型，这篇的横向对比能帮你省掉一轮试错
articles.author: Emre Kutlusan, Yongmin Li
articles.body: Foundation models pretrained on large natural-image collections are increasingly adapted for medical image segmentation, in the expectation that they will replace models trained for each task. Most comparisons, however, use data from the training distribution and a single task-specific baseline whose configuration is rarely justified, and therefore provide limited evidence of performance at new clinical sites. It also remains unclear how much of a foundation model must be adapted, and what determines this. We adapted a foundation model, DINOv2, with strategies ranging from tuning only its bias terms to full fine-tuning, and compared it with U-Nets and ResU-Nets trained from scratch. Experiments covered colonoscopy, breast ultrasound and dermoscopy, with testing on held-out data from the training source and on independent datasets from other institutions. The adapted foundation model generalised better on every external dataset. Within the training distribution, the task-specific models remained competitive when training data were abundant, and delineated boundaries more precisely, while the foundation model more often missed small lesions. Only a small fraction of the foundation model required adaptation, and the capacity needed was determined by the imaging domain rather than by the adaptation method. A widely used polyp test set was also found to duplicate images from another benchmark. Foundation-model adaptation is therefore warranted where models must work across sites, with capacity selected on the target domain.
articles.bodyZh: 在大量自然图像集上预训练的基础模型（foundation models），现在越来越多被改用来做医学图像分割（medical image segmentation），大家期待它们能取代针对每个任务单独训练的模型。不过，大多数对比用的都是训练分布（training distribution）里的数据，而且只跟一个任务专用基线（task-specific baseline）比，这个基线的配置还常常说不清为什么这么选，所以这些对比能说明的“在新临床站点表现如何”其实很有限。另外，一个基础模型到底需要适配（adapt）多少，什么因素决定这个量，也还不清楚。我们拿基础模型 DINOv2 做了适配，策略从只调偏置项（bias terms）一直到全量微调（full fine-tuning），再把它和从零训练的 U-Net、ResU-Net 做比较。实验覆盖结肠镜检查（colonoscopy）、乳腺超声（breast ultrasound）和皮肤镜（dermoscopy），测试既用了训练来源里留出的数据（held-out data），也用了其他机构独立数据集。结果，适配后的基础模型在每个外部数据集上都泛化得更好。在训练分布内，训练数据充足时，任务专用模型仍然很有竞争力，而且勾画边界更精确；基础模型则更容易漏掉小病灶（lesions）。基础模型里只有很小一部分需要适配，而且需要多少容量（capacity）是由成像域（imaging domain）决定的，不是由适配方法决定的。我们还发现，一个常用的息肉测试集（polyp test set）里存在和另一个基准数据集（benchmark）重复的图像。所以，如果模型要跨站点使用，就有必要做基础模型适配，并且要根据目标域来选容量。

articles.title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
articles.zh: 迈向基础检测模型：EM-DETR 中基于示例的 grounding
articles.summary: 如果你想让检测器"给几个样例就能找出新目标"，而不是每类都标注重训，这篇在 DETR 路线上给了一个可行解
articles.author: Sheethal Bhat, Bogdan Georgescu 等
articles.body: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated datasets. In medical lesion detection, the scarcity of comprehensive, stan dardized annotations and the heterogeneity of existing datasets limit the development of robust foundation models. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to building a multi-domain foundation model for le sion detection by integrating diverse medical image datasets annotated for both anatomical structures and abnormalities. We first propose a student-teacher training strategy to effectively combine datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and im proving feature learning. In addition, building on our previously pro posed example-based EM-DETR framework, we adapt it to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets, enabling fine-grained, example driven detection across modalities. Our model achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, with image-level AUC scores exceeding previous SOTA by 1% point on four key findings in CXRs. We achieve a leading mAP50 in CXRs and mammography, surpassing EM-DETR trained on a single dataset by 2-3% points. This approach paves the way for scalable foundation models in medical imaging that leverage heterogeneous data while maintaining robust and generalizable performance.
articles.bodyZh: 基于深度学习（Deep Learning, DL）的计算机辅助诊断（Computer-Aided Diagnostic, CAD）系统，在帮临床医生分担工作这件事上已经很有前景，但它的表现很吃数据——得有大规摸、标注质量高的数据集才行。在医学病灶检测（lesion detection）里，全面、标准化的标注本来就稀缺，现有数据集又各不相同，这就限制了稳健基础模型（foundation models）的发展。在这项工作里，我们提出了一种新办法：把多来源的医学图像数据集整合起来，构建用于病灶检测的多领域基础模型（multi-domain foundation model）；这些数据既有解剖结构（anatomical structures）的标注，也有异常（abnormalities）的标注。我们先提出一种师生式训练策略（student-teacher training strategy），把标签空间不一致（heterogeneous label spaces）的数据集有效合在一起，既缓解灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting），又提升特征学习效果。另外，在我们之前提出的基于示例的 EM-DETR 框架（example-based EM-DETR framework）基础上，我们做了适配，让它能从多个领域专属数据集里联合学习，从而支持跨模态（modalities）的细粒度、示例驱动检测。我们的模型达到了当前最优（state-of-the-art, SOTA）水平：在胸部X光片（CXR）的四项关键发现上，图像级 AUC（曲线下面积）分数比之前的最优结果高出1个百分点。在 CXR 和乳腺X线摄影（mammography）上，我们拿到了领先的 mAP50（IoU 阈值为0.5时的平均精度均值），比只在单一数据集上训练的 EM-DETR 高出2到3个百分点。这条路子为医学影像里的可扩展基础模型铺了路：既能利用异构数据，又能保持稳健、可泛化（generalizable）的表现。

articles.title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
articles.zh: AutoScaffold：AI 引导的脚手架式语言模型强化学习
articles.summary: 如果你在跑 LLM 的 RL 训练却卡在奖励稀疏、课程难设计上，这个让 AI 自己搭训练脚手架的思路值得借鉴
articles.author: Zijian Zhang, Rizhen Hu 等
articles.body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-time scaffolds, such as strategies or hints added to the prompt during training, offer a natural way to turn this information into guidance, but their design and adaptation are largely left to humans and tailored to specific domains. We introduce AutoScaffold, a unified AI-for-AI framework that turns a student's training experience into adaptive scaffolds, with minimal domain-specific information and no human intervention during training. A frozen teacher periodically examines this experience, diagnoses bottlenecks, and designs scaffolds in two forms: (i) strategies shared across a class of tasks and (ii) hints for individual hard tasks, adjusting the content and amount of support as the student learns. The scaffolds are removed at evaluation. We apply the same framework to ALFWorld, search-based QA, mathematical reasoning, and GPU kernel generation. When evaluated without scaffolds, students trained with AutoScaffold outperform those trained with the corresponding RL baselines in all four domains, with gains of 7.2 points in ALFWorld success and 4.0 points in average QA exact match. On GPU kernel generation, AutoScaffold increases the fraction of tasks with a correct kernel that runs faster than the PyTorch reference by up to 5.0 points. On math, our student surpasses QuestA's reported accuracy using approximately one-third as many student training steps. Analyses show that the teacher identifies a different failure in each task class and shifts its scaffolds from step-by-step workflows to targeted fixes as the student improves, and that its revised scaffolds help the student learn more than keeping the previous scaffold or using no scaffold.
articles.bodyZh: 可验证奖励的强化学习（Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards，RLVR）能产出很丰富的训练经验，但结果奖励（outcome rewards）会把每次尝试压成一个数字，大部分信息都没用上。训练时脚手架（training-time scaffolds），比如训练时往提示里加策略或提示，本来是很自然的一种方式，能把这些信息变成指导，可它们怎么设计、怎么调整，基本还是靠人，而且往往只针对特定领域。我们提出 AutoScaffold，一个统一的“AI 帮 AI”框架（AI-for-AI），能把学生模型的训练经验变成会自适应调整的脚手架，几乎不需要领域专属信息，训练过程中也不用人工插手。一个冻结的教师模型（frozen teacher）会定期翻看这些经验，诊断卡点，并设计两类脚手架：一类是一整类任务通用的策略，另一类是针对单个难题的提示；随着学生模型进步，它会调整支持的内容和力度。评估时会把脚手架撤掉。我们把这套框架用到了 ALFWorld、搜索式问答（search-based QA）、数学推理和 GPU 内核生成（GPU kernel generation）上。在不给脚手架的情况下评估，用 AutoScaffold 训练出来的学生模型，在四个领域都优于用对应强化学习基线训练出来的模型：ALFWorld 成功率涨了 7.2 个点，问答平均精确匹配（exact match）涨了 4.0 个点。在 GPU 内核生成上，AutoScaffold 把“生成了正确内核、而且跑得比 PyTorch 参考实现更快”的任务比例最多提高了 5.0 个百分点。数学上，我们的学生模型用的训练步数大约只有 QuestA 的三分之一，却超过了 QuestA 报告的准确率。分析显示，教师模型在每类任务里都能找出不同的失败点；随着学生变强，它给的脚手架会从一步步的工作流，转成更有针对性的修补；而且它改过的脚手架，比一直沿用旧脚手架或干脆不用脚手架，更能帮学生学到东西。

articles.title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
articles.zh: 对比式发现：在竞争性解释之上做开放式科学发现
articles.summary: 如果你想让模型不只吐一个答案、而是在多个竞争假说之间做判别和淘汰，这篇把"对比"本身变成了发现机制
articles.author: Ziang Liu, James J. Kim 等
articles.body: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. Across six domains, $89\%$ of the pointwise candidates with the largest belief shifts are rejections. On the same evidence, contrast sets resolve $73\%$ of these candidates to a specific alternative. When contrast sets guide search, the agent resolves $67\%$ more questions than pointwise surprisal under the same experiment budget. In a blinded study, $38$ human experts chose the same explanation on $78\%$ of resolved questions and on $82\%$ of questions where the pointwise agent rejected its hypothesis and stopped. Together, these results support explicit competing explanations as a way for discovery agents to resolve more scientific questions from the same evidence and validation budget.
articles.bodyZh: 现在越来越多的大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）被拿来做开放式、数据驱动的科学发现，但大多数智能体评估假设时都是逐个看的：只拿一个经验性说法 h 和它的反面 ¬h 来比。证据一旦否掉 h，智能体只知道有一种解释不太可能，却不知道证据到底支持哪种替代解释。为了把这个替代解释找出来，我们提出了对比式发现（Contrastive Discovery）：不再只提一个假设，而是给一个对比集（contrast set），也就是一个科学问题，配上一组互斥且穷尽（mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive）的竞争解释。每个实验的评分，看它的证据怎么在这组解释之间重新分配置信度；当置信度集中到某一个解释上，问题就算解决了。因为对比集只改变智能体提出和评分的单位，所以现有智能体可以直接用它重新评估已经收集到的证据，或者用它来指导搜索。在六个领域里，信念变化最大的逐点式（pointwise）候选中有 89% 都是被拒绝的。同样的证据下，对比集能把其中 73% 的候选落到一个具体的替代解释上。用对比集指导搜索时，在相同实验预算下，智能体解决的问题比逐点式意外度（pointwise surprisal）多 67%。在一项盲测里，38 位人类专家在 78% 已解决的问题上选了同一个解释；而在逐点式智能体拒绝自己的假设并停下来的问题中，这个比例是 82%。这些结果共同说明：把竞争解释明确摆出来，能让发现型智能体在同样的证据和验证预算下解决更多科学问题。

articles.title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
articles.zh: Agent 评估框架的对比分析：企业分析型 Agent 的稳定性、检测与发现能力
articles.summary: 如果你在做企业级数据分析 Agent，这篇提醒你现有评估框架在稳定性和真正的"发现"能力上并不都靠得住
articles.author: Howard Zhang, Chuck Arvin 等
articles.body: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative study of three evaluation frameworks, each representing a distinct evaluation paradigm (trace-based LLM judging, text-only LLM judging with red-teaming, and deterministic heuristics), applied to two analytics agents in a controlled research setting using frozen execution traces. Phase 1 quantifies evaluation harness stability through repeated measurements, finding that 97% of configurations meet the stability threshold and that stability patterns are agent-independent. Phase 2 measures known risk detection on 72 ground-truth test cases, where the trace-based framework achieves the best precision-recall balance (F1=0.90) while text-only evaluation matches on recall but generates 5x more false alarms. Phase 3 evaluates unknown risk discovery, uncovering 24 novel failures with zero overlap between functional testing and security red-teaming. Our results demonstrate that (1) the information available to the evaluation harness determines evaluation quality, (2) functional and security evaluation are complementary, and (3) LLM-based evaluation harnesses surface subtle errors that human reviewers miss. We recommend a two-framework strategy: trace-based evaluation for functional assessment and adversarial red-teaming for security validation.
articles.bodyZh: 要把基于大语言模型（LLM）的分析智能体（analytics agents）放到企业环境里用，就得有一套评估框架（evaluation frameworks），能靠谱地发现那些跨多个工具、流程又复杂的任务里到底哪儿出了岔子。我们做了一项三阶段对比研究，比较三种评估框架，它们分别代表一种不同的评估路子：基于执行轨迹的大模型评审（trace-based LLM judging）、纯文本大模型评审加红队测试（text-only LLM judging with red-teaming），以及确定性启发式规则（deterministic heuristics）。我们在受控的研究环境里，用冻结的执行轨迹（frozen execution traces），把这三套方法用在两个分析智能体上。第一阶段通过重复测量，量化评估装置（evaluation harness）的稳定性，结果发现 97% 的配置都达到了稳定性阈值（stability threshold），而且稳定性表现跟具体是哪个智能体没关系。第二阶段在 72 个有标准答案的测试用例（ground-truth test cases）上测已知风险检测，基于轨迹的框架在精确率-召回率平衡（precision-recall balance）上表现最好，F1=0.90；纯文本评估的召回率不相上下，但误报（false alarms）多了 5 倍。第三阶段看未知风险发现（unknown risk discovery），一共挖出 24 个此前没见过的失败案例，而且功能测试（functional testing）和安全红队测试（security red-teaming）之间零重叠。我们的结果说明三件事：第一，评估装置能拿到多少信息，直接决定评估质量；第二，功能评估和安全评估是互补的；第三，基于 LLM 的评估装置能揪出人类评审容易漏掉的细微错误。我们建议采用双框架策略（two-framework strategy）：功能评估用基于轨迹的评估，安全验证用对抗式红队测试（adversarial red-teaming）。

articles.title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
articles.zh: ReTrace：把工具调用 Agent 蒸馏成无需 planner 的工作流
articles.summary: 如果你被 Agent 在线规划的高延迟和高 token 成本拖累，这个蒸馏思路能把规划提前固化进轻量工作流里
articles.author: Kaiyuan Hou, Yang Ping Kuo 等
articles.body: Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they call an LLM to choose every step of every run, which adds latency and cost at scale. We present ReTrace, which turns an SOP and a few logged agent runs into a reusable workflow in which code, not an LLM, selects the next step. The agent's reasoning, the explanation it writes with each tool call, often states why it took an action; the tool calls alone do not. ReTrace extracts the condition behind each step, merges these conditions across runs into a compact rule document, and generates an executable workflow from it. Only this last stage depends on the platform, so rule documents can be compiled for different orchestration platforms. On $79$ procedures from our production platform, ReTrace workflows reach $93.8\%$ completion, against $96.8\%$ for the agent, at $24\%$ lower cost per task. On $τ^2$-Bench, they reach $75.8\%$ task success (agent: $80.6\%$) and run in $1.3$s instead of $170$s; three rounds of repair on training failures lift $k{=}2$ workflows from $66.7\%$ to $81.2\%$. On eight SOP-Bench procedures, ReTrace without repair trails few-shot generation ($80.6\%$ vs. $83.6\%$), but repair from labeled training failures lifts it to $87.8\%$ at $0.40$s per task, compared to $85.5\%$ in $46.6$s for the agent.
articles.bodyZh: 业务流程自动化（Business process automation）就是拿同一套标准操作流程（SOP），反复套到新的输入上跑。大语言模型（LLM）智能体（agents）能照着用自然语言写的 SOP 干活，但每跑一步都要调用一次 LLM 来决定下一步，规模一大，延迟和成本就上来了。我们提出 ReTrace，它能把一份 SOP 和少量记录下来的智能体运行记录，变成一个可复用的工作流：下一步由代码来选，而不是由 LLM 来选。智能体的推理——也就是它每次调用工具时写下的解释——常常会说明它为什么这么做；光看工具调用本身是看不出来的。ReTrace 会把每一步背后的条件抽出来，把这些条件跨多次运行合并成一份紧凑的规则文档，再据此生成可执行的工作流。只有最后这一步跟平台有关，所以规则文档可以编译到不同的编排平台上。在我们生产平台的 79 个流程上，ReTrace 工作流达到 93.8% 的完成率，智能体是 96.8%，但每个任务成本低 24%。在 τ²-Bench 上，任务成功率达到 75.8%（智能体 80.6%），运行时间 1.3 秒，而不是 170 秒；对训练中的失败做三轮修复后，k=2 的工作流从 66.7% 提升到 81.2%。在八个 SOP-Bench 流程上，不做修复的 ReTrace 略输少样本生成（few-shot generation，80.6% 对 83.6%），但用有标注的训练失败案例做修复后，能提升到 87.8%，每个任务 0.40 秒；相比之下，智能体是 85.5%，每个任务 46.6 秒。

articles.title: Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
articles.zh: Re-Search：用双人提问博弈拆解 LLM 的构思过程
articles.summary: 如果你想知道 LLM 的点子到底是怎么冒出来的，这个双人提问框架给了可观测、可拆解的实验手段
articles.author: Muhan Gao, Hangxiao Zhu 等
articles.body: Research ideation is iterative: researchers refine their ideas step by step based on feedback. Yet existing evaluations obscure this search process, making it difficult to understand how LLMs explore the space of research ideas and what limits their progress. We introduce Re-Search, which adapts the format of Twenty Questions to research ideation: given only the research problem of a published paper, a model must rediscover the paper's core idea by asking yes-or-no questions. Built from 200 ICML 2026 papers, Re-Search tracks how a model's idea evolves as it asks questions and receives binary oracle feedback, isolating ideation from execution. Across six recent LLMs, nearly all progress happens within the first 30 of 100 questions, which largely decide how the game ends; after that, most models plateau. Through controlled interventions on the candidate questions and the hypothesis space, we find that the bottleneck is generation, not judgment: models recognize a good idea or a good question when one is offered, but often cannot produce it on their own. We further analyze the ideation traces and find that models fail by either over-exploiting one direction or over-exploring too many. These findings point to concrete design principles for autoresearch systems: since models can judge candidates they cannot produce, enriching the search with externally sourced ideas and questions may be more effective than improving any single model's generation ability.
articles.bodyZh: 研究想法的产生是一个反复迭代的过程：研究者会根据反馈，一步一步把想法打磨得更好。但现有的评测把这种“搜索过程”给遮住了，让人很难看清大语言模型（LLM）到底是怎么探索研究想法空间的，也看不清是什么限制了它们往前走。我们提出了 Re-Search，它把“二十问”（Twenty Questions）的玩法搬到研究想法生成上：只给模型一篇已发表论文的研究问题，它必须通过问“是/否”问题，重新找出这篇论文的核心想法。Re-Search 基于 200 篇 ICML 2026 论文构建，会追踪模型在提问并收到二元“神谕”反馈（binary oracle feedback）时，它的想法是怎么一步步演变的，从而把“想点子”和“做实验/执行”分开来看。在六个较新的 LLM 上，几乎所有进展都发生在 100 个问题里的前 30 个问题内，而前 30 问基本就决定了最后结局；过了这个阶段，大多数模型就基本停滞（plateau）了。通过对候选问题和假设空间（hypothesis space）做受控干预（controlled interventions），我们发现瓶颈在“生成”（generation），不在“判断”（judgment）：只要把好想法或好问题递到模型面前，它往往能认出来，但它自己经常产不出来。我们又进一步分析了想法生成轨迹（ideation traces），发现模型失败通常有两种：要么过度利用（over-exploiting）一个方向，要么过度探索（over-exploring）太多方向。这些发现给自动科研系统（autoresearch systems）指出了具体的设计原则：既然模型能判断自己产不出来的候选想法，那么用外部来源的想法和问题来丰富搜索，可能比单纯提升某个模型的生成能力更有效。

articles.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Needs a Logic of Inference
articles.zh: 机制可解释性需要一套推断逻辑
articles.summary: 如果你在做 mechanistic interpretability，这篇是方法论层面的提醒：缺了推断逻辑，你画出的"电路"可能只是讲故事
articles.author: Zhimin Hu, Chen Jiang 等
articles.body: Neural networks are increasingly studied not merely as predictive systems, but as complex systems whose internal computations are themselves objects of scientific inquiry. Recent progress in mechanistic interpretability (MI) has made it possible to identify neurons, features, circuits, population structures, and dynamical patterns associated with model behavior. As these tools improve, attention is shifting from what can be observed inside a model to how those observations support mechanistic explanations. We examine the parallel efforts of neuroscience and MI to address this question and identify recurring inferential bottlenecks when inferring mechanisms from complex neural systems. We propose five principles and organize them into a recursive logic for a more rigorous procedure of mechanistic inference. These principles provide a framework that supports scientific discovery in two senses: it helps turn local interpretability findings into cumulative knowledge of mechanisms within models, and it makes those mechanisms sufficiently precise to generate testable hypotheses about domains beyond the models. Evidence beyond MI is ultimately required to establish what model mechanisms reveal about the world.
articles.bodyZh: 神经网络现在越来越多地被研究，不光是把它们当预测系统，更是把它们当成复杂系统：它们内部到底怎么算，本身就是科学研究的对象。最近机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability, MI）的进展，让我们能找出跟模型行为有关的神经元、特征、回路、群体结构和动态模式。随着这些工具越来越好，大家关注的重点也在变：从“模型里面能看到什么”，转向“这些观察怎么支撑机制层面的解释”。我们梳理了神经科学和 MI 在这件事上各自做的努力，也找出了从复杂神经系统中推断机制时反复出现的推理卡点。我们提出五条原则，并把它们组织成一套递归逻辑，用来支撑更严谨的机制推断流程。这套原则提供了一个框架，能在两层意义上帮助科学发现：一是把局部的可解释性发现，逐步积累成对模型内部机制的知识；二是让这些机制足够精确，从而能对模型之外的领域提出可检验的假设。说到底，要想知道模型机制到底揭示了世界的什么，还需要 MI 之外的证据。
